title: seed-applicants.yaml documents reference_contact_choice as submitted but the diff adds no executable step setting it
evidence:
+           reference_contact_choice="attested" (required attestation radio,
+           RC1.2 — the RC1.1 write path rejects missing/tampered values),
detail: Only the file's description block changes; no step or payload sets the field, and the referenced seed_config isn't in this diff. If the scenario doesn't already submit it, RC1.1's write path rejects every seeded applicant post-merge.
recommended_fix: Add reference_contact_choice to the scenario's actual submission payload (or shared seed_config) in this PR, or drop the description's claim that it is set.

title: validate_choice trims the posted value but error re-render re-selection compares the untrimmed value
detail: Validator trims; writer trims (per comment); the card's re-selection compares untrimmed common.get_val against exact values. A posted ' attested ' plus any unrelated field error re-renders with neither radio selected, silently dropping the applicant's choice.
recommended_fix: Trim when deriving selected: pass string.trim(common.get_val(...)) from references.gleam, or trim inside view_option before comparing with value.

title: Re-selection tests assert `checked` renders before `data-testid` though the attribute list appends it after
evidence:
+        attribute("required", ""),
+        attribute("data-testid", testid),
+      ]
+      |> list.append(checked_attrs),
+  html
+  |> string.contains("checked data-testid=\"ref-attestation-yes\"")
+  |> should.be_true
detail: The attribute list ends with data-testid, then list.append puts checked last; tests assert rendered order 'checked data-testid=...'. If Lustre preserves list order, re-selection tests fail and the no-default tests pass vacuously.
recommended_fix: Confirm Lustre's attribute serialization order; assert on an order-independent substring (data-testid plus a separate checked check) instead of adjacency.

title: Spec leaves the sprint-status task unchecked while the same diff performs the flip and marks the spec done
evidence:
+- [ ] `sprint-status-refcheck-v1.yaml` -- status flips -- bookkeeping per briefing (done at badge-out)
-  rc1-2-attestation-ui-the-references-section-choice: backlog
+  rc1-2-attestation-ui-the-references-section-choice: done
detail: Spec task for the sprint-status flip is unchecked and status says done, yet this same diff flips rc1-2 to done — the spec's own bookkeeping is stale and self-contradictory.
recommended_fix: Tick the task (or hold the sprint-status change) so the spec's task list matches what the PR actually contains.

title: review_loop_iteration: 0 contradicts the documented review-round-1 amendment
evidence:
+review_loop_iteration: 0
+- **Trigger (review round 1):** blind-hunter — every bug-hunt scenario that submits `/apply` fails post-merge (none select `reference_contact_choice`; the label-invariants classification rejects the new required radio); edge-hunter + blind-hunter — `validate_choice` read the untrimmed `common.get_val` while the insert/acknowledgement paths read the trimming `get_form_value`, so validator and writer disagreed on crafted whitespace values.
detail: Front matter records review_loop_iteration: 0, but the Spec Change Log documents a completed review round 1 amendment — the counter contradicts the log.
recommended_fix: Set review_loop_iteration to 1 (or renumber the change-log trigger) so metadata matches the documented review history.

title: Spec Code Map omits form_view_test.gleam, which the diff modifies
evidence:
+- `server/test/application/form_pages_test.gleam` -- signature updates + attested/declined confirmation assertions
diff --git a/server/test/application/form_view_test.gleam b/server/test/application/form_view_test.gleam
detail: The diff modifies form_view_test.gleam (confirmation signature update plus a new attestation-card test), but the spec's Code Map lists only the other two test files.
recommended_fix: Add form_view_test.gleam to the Code Map with a one-line description of the signature update and new pristine-render test.

title: Error span combines role="alert" with aria-live="polite"
detail: role="alert" carries an implicit aria-live of assertive; adding aria-live="polite" on the same node is contradictory and may downgrade the announcement the error-scroll pattern relies on.
recommended_fix: Drop the explicit aria-live attribute and keep role="alert" alone, matching the house view_error_span pattern.

title: Contradictory 'landlord will ring them' copy removed from the section hint but knowingly left in the landlord group
evidence:
-        html.text(
-          "Your landlord will ring every reference you list \u{2014} please fill them all in.",
-        ),
+- Any change to field-level helper copy inside the referee groups (e.g. "Your landlord will ring them…" in the landlord group) — out of the AC scope; left as-is, flagged as an open question in the PR.
detail: The section hint is removed for contradicting the Yes path (landlord doesn't ring referees), yet the spec's Ask First leaves the landlord-group helper 'Your landlord will ring them…' in place — the same contradiction survives.
recommended_fix: Resolve the open question in this PR: reword the landlord-group helper to match the attestation model, or record the follow-up issue explicitly.

title: New ref-heading class introduced with no styles added
detail: references.gleam introduces class ref-heading for the §5.2 framing heading, but the form.css hunk adds only attestation-* selectors; the new heading class has no styles anywhere in the diff.
recommended_fix: Add .ref-heading styles to form.css (or reuse an existing heading class) so the §5.2 intro doesn't render unstyled.
